title: Torsion subgroups and fixed-point rigidity in CAT(0) geometry
summary: We develop new methods for studying groups acting on CAT(0) spaces, which lead to several general structural results. First, we prove that every torsion subgroup of a CAT(0) group is finite, resolving a question of Swenson from the 1990s. The proof is based on showing that random walks on any finitely generated torsion group with bounded exponent acting on a CAT(0) space have zero drift. This is then combined with the fixed-point rigidity that we develop.
